title: Sandal Jepit
mood: tender and warmly amused, ten years into a marriage
subject: a husband giving his wife his own flip-flops when her strap snaps on the walk home from the night fair, and walking the last kilometre barefoot
caption: Indonesian langgam keroncong in the 1950s Solo style, a song-form keroncong with a sung refrain. Cak and cuk interlocking in the crong-crong offbeat strum pattern, a cello plucked with the thumb in kendang-like ciblon rhythms, a pizzicato contrabass on the downbeats, a nylon-string guitar running arpeggios, a flute obbligato weaving around the voice, and a violin countermelody between phrases. Acoustic and roomy, the ensemble in a small hall, the voice centered with the flute just behind it. Smooth, legato male voice with a slow, wide vibrato and keroncong cengkok on held notes, unhurried. 72 BPM, C major. Tender and warmly amused, ten years into a marriage. No drum kit, no bossa nova guitar, no synths, no autotune, no pop ballad chorus.
lyrics:
[Intro - flute over the cak and cuk strum]

[Verse 1]
Pulang dari pasar malam Sekaten
Arum manis di tanganmu tinggal separuh
Di depan gapura tali sandalmu putus
Engkau tertawa, lalu berjalan pincang

[Chorus]
Pakailah sandalku, wahai kasih
Biar kakiku saja yang menyentuh aspal
Sepuluh tahun aku berjalan di sampingmu
Satu kilometer lagi tidak mengapa

[Verse 2]
Sandalku kebesaran di kakimu
Berbunyi plak-plak sepanjang jalan kampung
Tetangga di teras melihat dan berbisik
Engkau gandeng tanganku lebih erat

[Instrumental Break - violin and flute over cak and cuk]

[Chorus]
Pakailah sandalku, wahai kasih
Biar kakiku saja yang menyentuh aspal
Sepuluh tahun aku berjalan di sampingmu
Kerikil pun terasa seperti pasir

[Outro - flute and slow cello]
Sampai di pintu, engkau basuh kakiku
Besok kita beli sandal kembar
